text_block_list.text:
Just moments before the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). With a calm heart, Mejiro 
McQueen reflects upon the days leading up 
to this point.

The days of hard work built together with 
Trainer. Memories of fierce battles with 
rivals. And then—

A showdown in the Takarazuka Kinen against 
Mejiro Ryan, who has found a stronger 
resolve as a Mejiro Umamusume.

With burning resolve in her heart... 
Mejiro McQueen declared that she would 
give it her all and run the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) to the very end.
